verdict.rationale: Ramp's Developer API is versioned: the canonical OpenAPI document is titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1), and endpoints use version-prefixed paths such as /developer/v1/transactions and /developer/v1/ai-usage/unified. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, changelog or breaking-change guarantees, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, a version lifecycle and support window, a changelog or breaking-change notification process, and independent corroboration.
